title: QueryMessage
description: Control-topic record format for the broker-side selector filter function. Each record is published to the control topic keyed by a stable query-id. The function maintains a Pulsar TableView over the control topic; publishes with a non-null body register or hot-reload the compiled selector for that query-id; publishes with a null/empty body (TableView tombstone) retract the query and stop fan-out. The JSON contract below describes the non-tombstone body; tombstones have no body and are not schema-validated.

name.description: Human-readable label used in function logs. Optional; absent or null is fine.

selector.description: JMS-selector expression — a SQL92 WHERE-clause subset evaluated against record bindings: __key__ (decoded UTF-8 message key), __topic__ (fully-qualified source topic with -partition-N stripped), and any Pulsar user property by name. Parsed by Apache ActiveMQ SelectorParser via com.datastax.oss:pulsar-jms-filters-common; SDKs validate selector syntax client-side before publishing. Must be non-empty.

outputTopic.description: Fully-qualified Pulsar topic the function writes matching messages to. The function honors forwardSourceMessageProperty and retainKeyOrdering, so payload bytes, key, and user properties are forwarded verbatim. Must be a persistent or non-persistent Pulsar topic FQN.

valueSchema.description: Full description of the consumer's value schema (forwarded by the orchestrator from the originating FilterRequest) so the function can decode the message value for schema-aware filtering. Optional; null/absent when the registering SDK supplied no value schema (byte[] / Kafka paths). Stored on the compiled query; the function uses it to construct a value decoder.

type.description: Schema type — Pulsar SchemaType.name(): JSON, AVRO, PROTOBUF_NATIVE, STRING, BYTES, etc.

definition.description: Base64 of Pulsar SchemaInfo.getSchema(): Avro .avsc / JSON-schema text / PROTOBUF_NATIVE descriptor. Null/empty for STRING/BYTES.

window.description: Set for a windowed query, null/absent for a live query. The function's subscription was positioned at fromMs; the function skips earlier records and writes a completion record (property __window_complete__=true, value = WindowStats JSON) when a record passes toMs or the record at the end position is processed. Times are epoch ms on the log's clock (broker-entry time when present, else publish time).

endLedgerId.description: Ledger of the topic's last message when the query was registered. Set together with endEntryId.

endEntryId.description: Entry of the topic's last message when the query was registered.

truncatedByRetention.description: True when fromMs is earlier than the earliest message still in the topic.
